scope: Borrowed standalone/paired vanilla and React suggestion controls: typed native proposal builders, pure previews, offline choices, original server outcomes and independent local receipt status. Actual application Wasm and installed public SDK/React entry points cover mixed comments/versions and permanent Reader controls. Protected-range namespace planning and proposal revision/rebasing remain functional work; this is not a V1 release.

verification.nativeSemanticsEvidence: Prior reviewed-history qualifications retain the canonical 480 native and 64 relay/server tests. This checkpoint changes UI/SDK code only; native history, effect proofs, server finality, Wasm and host artifacts are unchanged.

repairs.failure: A select field changed through a change event retained its initial value in the proposed native command
repairs.cause: Composer fields handled input only; heading/format change events did not update retained field values
repairs.fix: Handle input and change through the same field update. A regression asserts heading rank 4 and the actual selected italic format rather than their initial defaults. Native no-op admission remains unchanged.

repairs.failure: An older locally saved packet could visually imply that a newly discovered final receipt was already retained
repairs.cause: The display checked localSaved without comparing the locally retained final sequence to the discovered original decision
repairs.fix: Display uncached/pending final receipt, unconfirmed save and locally confirmed final receipt separately. A dedicated regression retains the older saved packet while final metadata arrives.

contracts: createSharedSuggestionPanelSource retains the exact native core, queue and optional existing sync adapter. checkQueue rejects a different queue instance. The bridge opens/closes no owner, database, lease, socket or asset store.

mountSharedSuggestionPanel is standalone; optional review-panel suggestions embeds the same controls beside independent comments/versions. BreditorSharedSuggestionPanel and the combined React review panel retain drafts and preview lifetime across ordinary parent renders.

Eight separately named action modules build original native text/format/heading/list/table/image intents. Native capture validates the complete source, schema, scalar boundaries, no-op refusal and budgets. No accepted AST snapshot, arbitrary inverse or browser effect executor is introduced.

The standard text builder emits the original same-flow range command. Protected cross-structure text needs the explicit native general-range draft and exact fresh floor identities; the stock builder does not guess them or silently flatten structures.

Up to 64 uniquely named typed actions with up to 16 fields are snapshotted per panel. Builders receive a read-only current view projection, entered values and explicit host fresh-ID allocation, not an accepted-document dispatcher. Missing allocation refuses and consumed namespaces remain consumed.

Capture and native preview leave document JSON, exact checkpoint and update frame unchanged. Accept needs a current owner-bound preview for the selected packet. Changed publication, selection choice or finality disposes it. Async packet loads recheck the same source and choice before preparing.

Accept/Reject queue locally without changing accepted content. Current authenticated server decisions finalize once; requested choice, final winner and local receipt durability remain separate. An opposite winner is displayed explicitly, not rewritten as success for the requested choice.

Failed saves retain the existing immutable packet and drafts. Local retry does not recapture. Publication retry requeues original bytes; stopping retries cannot withdraw requests already received by the server. Native-invalid/no-op drafts stay editable without a storage retry.

Read-only owners can capture/preview and Reject but cannot queue Accept through the UI. The actual permanent-observer transport additionally prevents author registration/resume/submit and Accept at the request layer; its native authored prefix stays zero.
Display policy callbacks and in-memory last rights do not authenticate current grants. Source/core/native guards and host authorization remain independently authoritative.

Disposal removes only owned UI DOM, subscriptions and preview handles. Already queued choices and pending saves remain host-owned. Still-running collaboration adapters may finish their own work after UI unmount; UI-port initiation is tested separately from host-owned wire traffic.
Preview content uses literal JSON/text and host-owned asset references, not executable HTML or implicit uploads. Existing source, queue, native, asset and storage meanings/limits are unchanged.
verificationNotes: The installed archive set includes both public SDK and optional React entries; React and React DOM resolve inside the installed consumer, not a workspace copy. Strict positive/negative type checks use those installed declarations.

The consolidated single-process installed command passes the owned-history/comment/version/control matrix followed by the permanent Reader/control matrix using the same four archive hashes. The Reader panel was additionally exercised against the earlier identical already-installed archive set: six pure previews/offline Rejects/final Rejects, zero author operations, and a readable native core/queue/live transport after UI disposal.

Synthetic DOM events stay in their own window realm. Replacing Node's global Event made native WebSocket EventTarget reject DOM events; only the harness was corrected. This is not a historical WebKit repair claim.

A post-unmount test initially counted every still-running host-owned adapter's wire request as UI polling. It now counts calls initiated through the UI load/sync port, while retaining the original whole-SDK no-idle-polling checks. The UI must not silently close those borrowed adapters.

The control-heavy fixture retains its original bounded network deadlines and verifies recovery before success; recovered request_timeout reports are allowed only in the expanded controls fixture. Original default regression admission stays unchanged. No production timeout or authorization check is relaxed.

IndexedDB/Web Locks, DOM, failed writes and lost replies are fixtures against an actual isolated native authenticated loopback host. Physical browser/clipboard/IME/accessibility/performance and final release qualification remain deferred.
remaining: Native namespace planning for stock protected cross-structure text suggestions, preserving exact floor identities without UI guessing. Existing typed native general-range drafts remain available to host action extensions.
Proposal revisions and granular character-affine text rebasing; conservative affected-text source witnesses remain unchanged.

Final V1 migration/API, package release, storage lifetime/compaction, production auth/hosting and deferred broad browser/IME/accessibility/performance qualification. The advanced-review goal remains active.
